The ATT is about **0.074** (outcome = employment status after training, treatment = job training).

I used the doubly robust (AIPW) estimator, which combines a logistic propensity model over x0–x16 with a logistic outcome model fit on the 2,333 untreated units. It gives 0.07396.

Other reasonable estimators land nearby, so the answer is not sensitive to the choice:

| Estimator | ATT |
|---|---|
| Naive difference in means | -0.089 |
| IPW (ATT weights) | 0.073 |
| Regression adjustment (logit outcome) | 0.073 |
| Regression adjustment (OLS outcome) | 0.069 |
| Doubly robust (AIPW), reported | 0.074 |
| 1-NN matching on propensity score | 0.089 |

The naive comparison is negative, but after adjusting for the covariates the effect is positive. I did not compute standard errors.

ANSWER: 0.074
